author: atomic_review

implementation.candidate_source: Census street range candidates only; no requirement for website. Existing jobIDs,input/database fingerprints,source-generation and explicit current public/owner snapshots retained.
implementation.precision: Every proposed number is street_interpolated, venue_verified:false, official_source_confirmed:false, writer_eligible:false. No_Match/Tie or mismatches have proposed:null/precisionunknown.
implementation.coverage: Any supplied eligible US state/DC full public address can qualify across listing families, no showcase/listingID allowlist. Per-batch input,eligible,excluded,uniqueaddress,dedup denominators retained.
implementation.transport: Default refuses before0calls. Named isolated injected mock transport only;4job/1MiB/30s caps, byte- and ID-bound CSV, explicit simulated HTTP vs query attempts, unknown allowance preserved, no automatic retry, bounded successful or malformed response bytes retained.
implementation.authority: No policy or provider activation; no new content store/queue, no canonical worker/ticket/writer changes, no coordinate apply.
implementation.owner_action: Only the existing geocoding action row corrected for Census estimate limits, compatible provider licensing, Mapbox MapLibre/public API gate and explicit cost/admission. No card/token-alone green state.

evidence_layers.source: Exact source pins and primary documentation; raw synthetic request/response/result retained.
evidence_layers.rendered: Generated owner-action payload tested. No public map change or browser acceptance claimed.
evidence_layers.journey: Mock request-to-candidate/defaultrefusal/failure recovery exercised. No production provider/owner/map journey.

remaining_limits: Initial preparation batch cap4 jobs/addresses, ordinary US states/DC only; PR/territory addressing and alternate benchmarks deliberately held.
Only documented benchmark4/Public_AR_Current admitted; Current is not immutable, response hash and capture time distinguish evidence.
Strict exact street/city/state/ZIP comparison can hold legitimate aliases/units; source or independent address review must reconcile them. No silent rewrite of stored address.

Current snapshot requires explicit owner/public/address/source-generation/fingerprint fields absent from some existing job.original payloads. No production snapshot exporter/admission adapter is supplied.
The input checksum detects changed bytes; it is not server authority or authentication. All outputs remain authority:none and writer_eligible:false.

The mocked adapter may reserve/count query slots in memory for test evidence only; no durable budget reservation, ticket consumption, archive upload/readback or actual provider idempotence is implemented.
All network default disabled. Only a named isolated test contract accepts injected transport; no built-in fetch, secrets or real provider path. OpenCage/Mapbox remain unadmitted.

A live candidate path needs separately reviewed finite tickets, private rawCSV archive/readback and current generation validation. Any public apply needs distinct honest precision writer/read/UI work and actual map journeys.
